origin: Independent frozen original C API, original GGUF writer and original quantize_chunk; no Rust expected values

scope: Dense causal LM only; noncausal/scaled/array/head graphs remain explicitly rejected. Native abort is recorded for partial RoPE. Overflow norm is a checked atomic runtime failure in Rust.
